title: Missing Canvas Submission Streak
dataSources: Canvas assignments (`canvas:assignment`), Khan Academy SAT practice (`khan:sat`), Family Link usage (`familylink:usage`), and OurHome chores (`ourhome:chore`).
app: Canvas LMS exports, Khan Academy SAT practice, Google Family Link screen-time data, and OurHome chore tracking streamed to Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=canvas:assignment submission_status="missing"
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as missing_assignments by _time student_name
| sort 0 student_name _time
description: Trends weekly clusters of missing Canvas submissions per student.
value: A streak of missed submissions is usually more meaningful than a single late night or one forgotten worksheet.
implementation: Schedule a weekly rollup of Canvas assignments with `submission_status=missing` and share it in a calm review loop.
visualization: Weekly column chart of missing assignments by student.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks when missing homework stops being a one-off and starts becoming a pattern.
